messages:
Maria Cho: Quick heads-up — pleased to announce Tess Nguyen is joining Redwood as Senior Go‑to‑Market Liaison on May 6. She'll sit with Product & GTM and report to Ash Sinha. Background: Sr. partner ops at DataWorks, formerly on Sales at Nimbus AI. Primary focus: partner enablement for Dedicated & Private, onboarding playbooks for Solutions Eng, and downstream enablement for Sales. Please welcome Tess! :tada:

Ash Sinha: Amazing news, Maria — welcome Tess! We'll schedule a 30m intro this week. Looking forward to faster partner rollouts. :raised_hands:

Tess Nguyen: Hi all — really excited to join Redwood. Happy to jump on intro calls, share my onboarding checklist, and start meeting partners next week. Thanks for the warm welcome!

Ana Gomez: Welcome, Tess! I can set up a joint session with Solutions Eng and CS to map handoffs. When are you free next Tue/Wed?

Tess Nguyen: Tue afternoon works best for me.

Maria Cho: Quick org note — as part of this ramp we’re adjusting a small reporting matrix: Solutions Eng will have a dotted line to Product Success for partner program prioritization. Primary reporting remains under Eng Platform. Doc with the diagram: https://redwood.internal/org/diagrams/solutions-eng-reporting (internal).

DevEx Team: FYI — we'll add Tess to the onboarding templates, partner playbook repo, and the Dedicated deployment runbooks. @People Ops Bot will trigger account setup.

People Ops Bot: Account provisioning started for Tess Nguyen. New hire checklist created: onboarding playbook, workspace access, dev VPN. Estimated completion: 48 hours.

Ash Sinha: Thanks folks. Action items: (1) Ana to schedule Solutions Eng intro with Tess, (2) DevEx to add playbooks & set pair sessions, (3) Maria to update the org diagram in the handbook. I'll run the first partner enablement sync post-onboard.

Ana Gomez: Got it — I'll send calendar invites after confirming Tess's Tue slot.

Maria Cho: Thanks team. Tess — ping me if you need any pre-reads. Excited to have you aboard! :rocket:
